messages:
Maria G: Heads-up, we need a single checklist for private metrics export agents — VPC/on-prem customers keep hitting firewall/KMS/audit issues.
Noah K: +1. Do we want push (agent -> cloud) or pull (collector inside VPC)? Customer preference varies.
Priya S: For Redwood Private we prefer push over TLS with mTLS optional. Pull requires extra inbound rules on customer side.
Chen W: Key constraints: outbound-only port 443, allow DNS, and IPs for collector endpoints. KMS calls need to reach kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com (example).
Maria G: Draft checklist idea:
- outbound egress to collector fqdn + IP ranges
- TLS (443) required
- optional mTLS cert bundle support
- KMS endpoint allowed
- auditlog webhook reachable
- Agent heartbeat metric (agent_online)
Noah K: can you add expected metrics names? Ops/Console needs them for dashboards.
Priya S: Proposed metrics: agent_online (0/1), export_latency_ms (histogram), export_errors_total, last_audit_seq (gauge), queued_batches, auth_retry_count
Chen W: Add labels: customer_id, agent_version, region, export_target
Maria G: also include rate-limiting / quotas note: agents should backoff with jitter if 429, expose export_backoff_count metric
Noah K: For firewall rules we should provide example CIDR list and fallback to DNS name. Example rule:
```
egress: tcp 443 -> collector.redwood-inference.com (use FQDN+CIDR)
allow: 169.254.169.254 for IMDS? NO (don't require)
```
Priya S: KMS: customers need to allow Redwood's KMS proxy endpoint OR provide an external KMS gateway. Example ARN pattern we call: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE
Maria G: Audit log hooks: agent will POST audit chunks to customer's S3 or syslog; or we can push to customer's audit webhook. Need sample HMAC header for verification.
Chen W: sample webhook header:
```
X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=...
X-Redwood-Timestamp: 1670000000
```
Priya S: UX/Console side: product needs a per-agent mini-dashboard with:
- last_seen
- export_rate, avg_latency
- last_audit_seq + link to raw logs
- KB link to firewall checklist
Noah K: Routing/policy note: If a customer uses regional routing, agent should prefer regional endpoint (collector.us-east-1.redwood.ai) — include endpoint discovery via /.well-known/redwood-agent
Maria G: onboarding flow: agent installer will run connectivity checks:
- DNS -> resolve collector
- TLS handshake test
- KMS encrypt/decrypt test (with placeholder key)
- webhook post test (200 OK)
Priya S: Can eng-infra own the connectivity test endpoints? @Chen W will you?
Chen W: Yup. I'll provision test endpoints and return CIDRs. ETA EOD Thu.
Maria G: Who will write the KB draft? I can start it, will include checklist + code snippets.
Noah K: I can wire the console side for metrics ingestion mapping to dashboards. Will need example metric names and labels (listed above).
Priya S: Security: require audit logging of key access. Also need guidance to customers about not whitelisting 0.0.0.0/0.
Maria G: OK next steps:
- Chen: test endpoints + CIDR by Thu EOD
- Maria: KB + checklist draft by Fri
- Noah: dashboard proto by Mon
- Priya: agent backoff + metrics impl PR
Chen W: noted.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: infra/test-endpoint v1.2 -> prod
Maria G: thanks all — will post draft when ready :rocket:
